caption: The drawing features a single object that appears to be a detailed and intricate tool or decorative item. The object is rendered in grayscale, giving it a metallic or stone-like appearance. It has a flat, elongated body with an open lattice structure in the central region, featuring interwoven diagonal bands and raised, regularly spaced projections. The left end of the object is rectangular with a small hole set within a section of parallel grooves. The opposite end branches into two arched, curved prongs, each with a textured surface and terminating in rounded ends, and a third, shorter projection extends downward. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details present, and the artist's signature "G. Sanborn" is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Bootjack
